split.rule: t0 = timestamp(start_block), t1 = timestamp(end_block), T = t0 + floor(0.7 * (t1 - t0)) snapped down to the 30-second tick grid anchored at t0
split.learning_entry_rule: an entry is allowed only if cutoff + 902 <= T

reuse.rule: the same store, the same cutoff T, the same admission_v2 and comparison_v1 seeds that are not keyed to the learned state; reuse is checked by --verify-reference, never assumed

reference_verification.rule: identical seeds and identical weights must give identical valences; a single disagreement stops the wave
